text:
jamie: Heads-up — planning a canary rollout for model-serving v2 tomorrow during the change window (02:00-03:00 UTC). Need approvals for traffic split, quota guards, and rollback thresholds. Deploy plan below.

jamie: ```yaml
rollout:
  name: model-serving-v2-canary
  traffic_split: 5
  guard_rules:
    - name: error_rate_threshold
      metric: error_rate
      threshold: 0.5%
      window: 1m
      action: rollback
    - name: latency_p90
      metric: latency_p90_ms
      threshold: 500
      window: 2m
      action: pause
  fallback: model-serving-v1
  exclude_customers: [internal, corp]
```

jamie: Trigger command we'll run: `/deploy canary model-serving-v2 --split=5 --guards "err>0.5%:1m,lat_p90>500ms:2m"`

deploy-bot: Preflight checks: config lint OK, artifact checksum OK, infra quota OK. Waiting for 2 approvers from eng-releases.

rob: quick q — why 5% instead of 1%? 5% might spike costs and affect SLOs for everyone.

jamie: 5% chosen because we need signal on latency and KV-cache behavior; 1% won't show steady-state latency. We also have auto-rollback at 1.5x baseline error rate so blast radius is limited.

anika: Also: are we applying per-customer throttles during canary? want to avoid one tenant skewing metrics. Suggest adding a quota guard: `max_qps_per_customer: 10` and an intent to divert heavy customers to v1 during canary.

dave: +1 for the quota guard. Can we add an explicit telemetry tag so dashboards show canary vs prod? otherwise our dashboard filters will be noisy. Something like `rollout_meta: {env: canary, cohort: 5pct}`.

maya: :thumbsup: Approved. I sign off on traffic split + guard rules.

release-bot: Change-window approval required from oncall and infra-ops. Current change window: 2026-03-19 02:00-03:00 UTC.

rob: oncall here — I approve the window. Go ahead.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 2026-03-19T02:00:00Z. Will post status updates to this thread. To abort before start: `/deploy-cancel model-serving-v2-canary`. Post-deploy checks will include p90 latency, error rate, and per-tenant skew.

jamie: Thanks all — I'll add the quota guard and telemetry tag, then ping ops for final signoff in the morning.
